text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Daiichi Ruby and her classmate 
Nakayama Festa were asked to prepare 
teaching materials together, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Prepare yourself, Ruby. If I win, you're 
carrying the teaching materials all by 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No problem.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh. Not even a bat of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun, I'll raise. If I lose, I'll 
run 10 laps around the school building 
carrying teaching materials.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I fail to see the purpose of needlessly 
increasing risk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Like that would—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I just want a thrilling, high-stakes 
match, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Ruby! Why don't we play a game since 
we're here? The loser has to carry all 
those teaching materials by themselves."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"I will decline your offer. If you do not 
wish to carry it, I will carry it alone."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As my classmate, you already know about my 
ridiculous luck in competitions, right? 
...Maybe you'll finally find out what's 
really behind it?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(By pushing myself daily, I become 
stronger against pressure and draw closer 
to supremacy.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(This posture is the true secret behind 
her clutch strength. ...In that case——)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will call. If I lose, the same terms 
will apply to me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Hahaha! Just as I thought, you're 
the best...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us reveal our hands—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Phew... How was that?
choice_data_list:
Your running's definitely gotten much 
sharper. But...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If you are concerned about overwork from 
independent training, there is no need to 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It's simply a matter of having changed my 
mindset as I go about my days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't entirely sure what had happened, 
but... in this way, Daiichi Ruby's running 
became even more refined.
